country: BE
name: De Panne
notes: Very wide beach, best at high tide per guides; IKO school Stevo Kitesurf on the beach. Kiting goes through the beach clubs and schools (day membership reported, check on site). Also: Oostduinkerke – Groenendijk (Surfclub Windekind, Sycod) 6 km east.

country: BE
name: Oostende
notes: Mariakerke side, near Surfclub Inside Outside (its lessons are surf and windsurf; kite lessons not confirmed). Guides list Oostende as a kite spot; club or school access reported as required, check on site. Often crowded. Also: Bredene (Twins Club) next door; De Haan, Wenduine, Blankenberge club beaches further east.

country: BE
name: Zeebrugge
notes: Surfclub Icarus (kite lessons) on the beach between Zeebrugge and Blankenberge: flatter water, no breakwaters. Kite leash compulsory, keep out of swim and surf zones (lifeguards enforce in summer). Club access reported as required, check on site.

country: BE
name: Knokke-Heist
notes: Duinbergen (Beachclub Anemos has a kite and windsurf desk). Wide beach at low tide; club access reported as required, check on site. Also: Het Zoute (Surfers Paradise, advanced) 4 km east.
